title: parcel.status.updated
description: Published by S2 Parcel & Pricing for every accepted parcel status change. Kafka topic parcel.status.updated, key = parcel id (aggregateId). Delivery is at-least-once; consumers de-duplicate on eventId. Contains no names, phone numbers, addresses, notes or customer ids; merchantId (merchant parcels only) is the merchant account id.

actorRole.description: Role that made the change, for example DISPATCHER or SERVICE. Never the user id.

merchantId.description: Merchant account id (the merchant's Keycloak subject). Present only for merchant parcels; absent for customer bookings. Optional, added for merchant webhooks (#32).
